content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (target) reproduces the Peterson reaction forward: C-C double bond formed, carbon-silicon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken (beta-hydroxy silane elimination). So functional groups formed: C-C double bonds. Broken: ketones? Wait description: "ketones and trimethylsilyl groups are lost". So functional groups broken: ketones? Actually forward reaction: starting from beta-hydroxy silane (has C-O bond (alcohol) and C-Si bond) and after elimination yields alkene and Si group leaves as siloxane? The description says ketones are lost? Might be mis-match. But we need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "C-C double bonds". functional_groups_broken includes "ketones" and "trimethylsilyl". Also bonds broken: C-O, C-Si? bonds formed: C=C. Let's search.
